name: localtunnel-monorepo
description: LocalTunnel — expose home services to the public internet through your own VPS, even behind CGNAT.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @localtunnel/protocol && npm run build -w @localtunnel/gateway && npm run build -w @localtunnel/agent && npm run build -w @localtunnel/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=120000 "packages/protocol/test/*.test.js" "packages/gateway/test/*.test.js" && npm run test:installer
